proposals.before: Book of Sui, 52th year of Volume, 17th year of Biographies.
proposals.reason: Mistranslates 卷五十二 / 列傳第十七 as ordinal "year" instead of volume and biography numbers.

proposals.before: Han Qinhu, whose courtesy name was Zitong, came from Donyuan in Henan; his family later moved to Xin'an.
proposals.after: Han Qinhu, whose courtesy name was Zitong, came from Dongyuan in Henan; his family later moved to Xin'an.
proposals.reason: 東垣 is Dongyuan, not Donyuan.

proposals.before: Han Qinhu, courtesy name Zitong, was a native of Donyuan in Henan; later his family settled in Xin'an.
proposals.after: Han Qinhu, courtesy name Zitong, was a native of Dongyuan in Henan; later his family settled in Xin'an.
proposals.reason: 東垣 is Dongyuan, not Donyuan.

proposals.before: When Chen troops pressed Guangzhou, Qinhu, serving as Campaign Commander, routed them.
proposals.after: When Chen troops pressed Guang Prefecture (Guangzhou), Qinhu, serving as Campaign Commander, routed them.
proposals.reason: 光州 is Guang Prefecture, not the city commonly meant by Guangzhou (廣州).
Inconsistent spacing of the surname He Ruo / given name Bi versus He Ruobi used elsewhere in the chapter.

proposals.before: He Ruo Bi, whose courtesy name was Fubo, came from Luoyang in Henan.
proposals.after: He Ruobi, whose courtesy name was Fubo, came from Luoyang in Henan.
proposals.reason: Aligns personal-name spacing with the predominant chapter form He Ruobi.

decisions.reason: s0001 reads 隋書卷五十二列傳第十七; 卷 marks the volume and 列傳第十七 the biography section number, so “year of Volume/Biographies” is a clear mistranslation and the proposed wording matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 隋書卷五十二列傳第十七

decisions.reason: s0003 has 河南東垣人; 東垣 romanizes as Dongyuan, so idiomatic “Donyuan” is a spelling error and the proposed Dongyuan is correct.
The same 東垣 in s0003 requires Dongyuan in the literal field; “Donyuan” is simply the wrong romanization.

decisions.after: When Chen troops pressed Guang Prefecture, Qinhu, serving as Campaign Commander, routed them.
decisions.reason: s0011 has 光州, the prefecture Guang, not 廣州 the city usually meant by bare “Guangzhou.” The proposed parenthetical still reuses that ambiguous city form; naming the place Guang Prefecture alone fixes the identity without inviting the 廣州 reading.
s0123 is only the heading 賀若弼; “He Ruo Bi” already names the same person, and respacing to “He Ruobi” is a chapter-style preference rather than a semantic or attribution error.
s0124’s 賀若弼 is already correctly identified; changing “He Ruo Bi” to “He Ruobi” only normalizes spacing to another acceptable English form and does not repair meaning.

claimRevisions.reason: Advanced r0004 shows the engagement was at 光州 (Guang Prefecture); the event-participation action must not use bare Guangzhou, which English readers take as 廣州.
